title: dnaa-9 — asynchronous initiation over-replicates without a re-initiation control
caption: Config: DNAA_HYDROLYSIS_RATE_PER_MIN=0.025 + threshold 8 + async, RIDA/DDAH/DARS off (seed 1). The hydrolysis rate puts the total DnaA-ATP fraction in the [0.2,0.5] band (mean 0.24) and the trigger fires at full oriC-low occupancy (1.0). But because each oriC binds DnaA and initiates INDEPENDENTLY with nothing throttling re-initiation, the origins re-fire continuously — oriC runs to 3/4/5 and total DnaA climbs above [300,800].
interpretation: Two of the targets (DnaA-ATP fraction in band via hydrolysis; full-occupancy firing) are met, and per-origin asynchronous initiation is in place — but async ALONE over-replicates. A re-initiation frequency control (SeqA) is required; that is dnaa-10.
